title: 酒店入住 · 换安静房
intro: 前台常用句：房型、早餐、朝向、Wi-Fi、退房时间。

sentences.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation with us?
Yes, under the name Chen. I booked a double room for three nights.
sentences.zh: 有的，姓陈。我订了一间双人房，住三晚。

sentences.en: Let me check. Yes, here it is. Could I see your ID, please?
sentences.zh: 我查一下。找到了。可以看下您的证件吗？

sentences.en: Sure. Is breakfast included in the price?
It is, from seven to ten in the morning on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 含的，早上七点到十点，在二楼。

sentences.en: Great. Could I get a room away from the street? I'm a light sleeper.
sentences.zh: 太好了。能给我一间不临街的房间吗？我睡觉很轻。

sentences.en: I'll put you on the eighth floor, facing the garden.
sentences.zh: 我给您安排八楼，朝向花园。

sentences.en: That sounds perfect. What's the wifi password?
sentences.zh: 那太好了。Wi-Fi 密码是什么？

sentences.en: It's on the card in your room. Check-out is at noon.
sentences.zh: 房间里的卡片上写着。退房时间是中午十二点。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot. Have a good night.
